questions.explanation: In functional (secondary) mitral regurgitation (FMR), the mitral valve leaflets and chordae tendineae are structurally normal. The regurgitation is driven by left ventricular remodeling, annular dilatation, and papillary muscle displacement that cause apical and lateral leaflet tethering. Transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) or surgery is considered only if severe symptomatic MR persists despite optimal GDMT.
